known_upstream_conditions.condition: CMS_encrypt/CMS_encrypt_ex encrypts to an attacker-controlled EC recipient certificate
OpenSSL native QUIC automated peer detection
AES-GCM-SIV initialization using a nonstandard IV length

scanner_boundary: Current Grype identifies curl as one binary, not its separate embedded libssl/libcrypto. The absence of these five tuples in raw reports is not evidence of a fixed library. They are additional known embedded-component conditions and do not alter the original reports.

actual_build_and_source.tcp_tls_selection: lib/vtls/openssl.c:3677 selects TLS_client_method. The cipher options at3873/3887 call SSL_CTX_set_cipher_list / SSL_CTX_set_ciphersuites and select TLS cipher suites, not generic EVP AES-GCM-SIV.
actual_build_and_source.curl_cli_source: src C/H contains no CMS_encrypt/PKCS7_encrypt, EVP cipher initialization/fetch, GCM-SIV, OSSL_QUIC or SSL_CTX_FUNCTION callback entry.
actual_build_and_source.actual_http3: configure HTTP3=no, proxy-HTTP3=no; actual --version features omit HTTP3; the currently built curl does not expose a QUIC transport.
actual_build_and_source.tls_cipher_source: Official openssl-3.5.9 ssl/s3_lib.c and ssl/ssl_ciph.c list TLS suite implementations. GCM-SIV is not a TLS cipher suite. Normal AES-GCM is not equated with AES-GCM-SIV.
actual_build_and_source.libssh2_package: Independently extracted signed APK .PKGINFO from exact libssh2-static-1.11.1-r4.apk; archive43f5c31cfea7d96426fe6d65ecb768edba65657667eb1f90e90be22f942e3a16, PKGINFO3068b7f864139c65e7938cf317394af6a0d890e553a60acf3edfe3181102982a, commit5b3f244265eaf572693cbba1ac4b2548287980ff.
actual_build_and_source.libssh2_source: Official1.11.1 crypt.c SSH algorithm table and openssl.h bind AES-GCM/CTR/CBC through fixed EVP_aes_* functions. openssl.c compares AES-GCM EVP function pointers; no GCM-SIV, CMS encryption or QUIC entry. Exact Alpine source commit APKBUILD plus all11 listed vendor patches captured; none introduces the affected entry/algorithm names. This is source-selection corroboration, not a fresh reproducible compilation of the vendor APK.
actual_build_and_source.configuration: Actual914-entry image manifest contains no openssl.cnf, engines or ossl-modules path. Image runtime9-field config remains the retained MinIO contract with no external OpenSSL config/provider environment.
actual_build_and_source.actual_service_entry: Current project Compose minio command is silo server; healthcheck is silo healthcheck, not curl. Silo/mcli use their pinned Go TLS graph; actual normal curl loopback HTTP was a separate benign fixture check.
actual_build_and_source.elf_symbols: Actual stripped curl has no .symtab. The attempted metadata reader reports no symbol section; no claim of absence of embedded vulnerable functions is made.

conclusion: Supports exclusion of these five affected features from the pinned current MinIO service and normal curl TLS/SSH implementation paths, not a fixed OpenSSL package. Current raw scan counts and severities remain unchanged.

No crafted malicious input, vulnerability reproduction, model request, code edit or remote mutation was performed.
